decision.summary: A multi-component offset begins ~538: N and U show sharp, sustained upward shifts (N rises ~6–8 MAD, U ~8–10 MAD), while E drops ~4–5 MAD. The offset persists through the end of allowed context (579) without clear reversal; thus, only an uncertain temporary interval can be assigned. A secondary E change near 576 is isolated and not paired with opposing N/U motion, insufficient for a separate temporary interval.

intervals.observation: N and U rise sharply starting ~538–540 (multi-sample onset), sustained plateau through ~544–575, with E dropping concurrently (~538–542) and remaining offset; no opposing return observed within allowed context [501,579]. Return is ambiguous/unobserved beyond 579, so status uncertain.
